Doubling the unit doubles the power, Randall. Two 40Ts in Eco is about 900W, roughly $72 a month at your Kansas rate. Standard mode, about 1300W, roughly $104 a month.

That's the honest number. Also 1300W of heat in the shop, which is welcome in January and less so in July.

Nothing stops you starting with one and adding the second later if the bill sits fine.
I have a 3200 square foot shop so don't think it will matter on the heat

In 3200 square feet, 1300W is nothing, you're right. Two space heaters' worth spread over a shop that size.

Noise is the thing to think about more than heat, they're small fans and they do whine. Fine in a shop, less fine next to a desk.
